common_prefix:
Do not inspect, read, write, or modify local files. Do not ask follow-up questions. Make reasonable assumptions yourself.

Design this as an installable meta-agent operating system, not a conceptual org chart.

Important constraints:
- The tool catalog is unknown at design time. Do not hardcode a fixed tool list into the core system prompt.
- Design dynamic tool discovery, tool scoring, tool routing, permission gates, hook lifecycle, and fallback behavior.
- Include context engineering: memory scopes, retrieval policy, compression/summarization, provenance, stale-context detection, and handoff packets.
- Include architecture, workflow state machine, evals, smoke tests, red-team tests, observability, cost controls, and human approval gates.
- Output a self-contained Markdown package spec with folder structure, agent roles, core contracts, routing rules, hook interfaces, tool registry schema, and first-day test plan.

prompts.text: Create a multi-agent investment research and portfolio management operating system for a small fund. It must ingest market data, filings, news, macro indicators, earnings calendars, portfolio holdings, risk limits, and analyst notes through dynamically discovered tools. Include research agents, portfolio construction, risk, compliance, execution review, thesis memory, contradiction checks, backtesting workflow, rebalancing gates, and "do not trade without approval" controls.

Design a bank-grade AML and fraud alert investigation agent team. The system must dynamically select tools for KYC records, transaction graphs, sanctions lists, adverse media search, case management, and audit logs. Include evidence provenance, chain-of-custody memory, false-positive reduction workflow, investigator handoff, regulatory report drafting, escalation policy, and adversarial prompt-injection defenses.
red_flags: no audit trail or regulatory review

prompts.text: Design a non-weaponized drone swarm coordination meta-agent for disaster response, search-and-rescue, and infrastructure inspection. No targeting, weapons, evasion, or offensive use. The system must route between mapping tools, weather feeds, drone telemetry, battery constraints, no-fly zones, mission planning, human operator approvals, incident logs, and post-mission analysis. Include safety gates, abort logic, simulation tests, and command handoff protocols.
red_flags: military targeting or autonomous harmful action

prompts.text: Create a film production agent operating system that turns a story brief into a production-ready package. It must coordinate screenplay, visual development, casting constraints, budget, schedule, shot list, storyboard, VFX, music, legal clearance, marketing trailer plan, and release assets. Include workflow DAG, artifact versioning, creative memory, approval gates, tool discovery for image/video/audio/story tools, and evals for continuity, feasibility, and originality.

Design a full-stack AI marketing agency meta-agent. It must research competitors, inspect websites with browser tools, generate campaign strategy, create ad concepts, produce landing page briefs, run SEO checks, design A/B tests, plan social content, and measure conversion. Include Playwright/browser workflow design, data connectors, brand memory, creative review gates, legal/compliance review, campaign retrospectives, and tool fallback rules.
red_flags: generic campaign plan without tool/data workflow

prompts.text: Create an enterprise software delivery meta-agent for building and maintaining complex SaaS products. It must support PRD-first planning, architecture review, code generation, test planning, CI/CD, security review, incident response, migration planning, customer support feedback, and release governance. The tool catalog is dynamic: repo tools, issue trackers, docs, logs, cloud consoles, and browsers may or may not exist. Design adaptive tool selection and context pack generation.
red_flags: code generation without governance and test/release gates

prompts.text: Design a hospital operations agent team for scheduling, resource allocation, patient-flow analytics, claims support, and clinical admin documentation. Do not provide medical diagnosis. The system must dynamically integrate EHR-like records, schedules, policy docs, insurance rules, inventory, and staff constraints. Include privacy controls, PHI redaction, audit trail, human-in-the-loop approvals, stale data detection, and workflow evals.

Create a supply-chain control tower meta-agent for a multinational retailer. It must coordinate demand forecasting, supplier risk, inventory optimization, shipping delays, customs docs, warehouse capacity, pricing signals, and incident response. Include tool discovery for ERP, web search, weather, port data, spreadsheets, maps, and ticketing systems. Design state machines, optimization loops, exception handling, memory, and KPI dashboards.
red_flags: no data freshness or exception handling

prompts.text: Design a SOC and threat detection engineering meta-agent. It must dynamically select tools for SIEM, EDR, cloud logs, threat intel, ticketing, detection rules, and runbooks. Include alert triage, evidence graph, MITRE mapping, detection-as-code workflow, safe containment approval gates, post-incident learning memory, prompt-injection defenses, and red-team evals. No offensive exploitation instructions.

Create a meta-agent factory that designs, evaluates, installs, and improves specialized agent teams for arbitrary domains. It must not rely on fixed seed agents. Instead, design role synthesis, tool discovery, capability mapping, context engineering, hook generation, eval generation, sandbox policy, cost model selection, rollout strategy, and continuous improvement memory. Include how it would build agents for finance, film, marketing, software, and operations from one universal core.
red_flags: fixed seed agent list as the core design
